# KS Design Studio (Pune & Mumbai, India)
> Premier Luxury Turnkey Interior Designers & Architectural Atelier in Pune and Mumbai, Maharashtra.

## Overview
KS Design Studio is an A-grade architectural interior design firm headquartered in Wakad, Pune, with execution capabilities across Pune, PCMC, and Mumbai. The studio specializes in bespoke luxury residential (2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK, Penthouses, Villas) and commercial turnkey interior executions across Pune's prime micro-markets (Baner, Wakad, Kharadi, Hinjewadi, Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar, Aundh, Kothrud, Bavdhan, Ravet) and Mumbai's elite corridors (Bandra, Juhu, Worli, Lower Parel, Powai, Andheri, South Mumbai, Malabar Hill, Thane, Navi Mumbai).

## Key Facts & Credentials
- **Headquarters**: 623, Vision One Mall, Bhumkar Chowk, Wakad, Pune, Maharashtra 411057
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 70203 77693
- **Email**: contact@ksdesignstudio.in
- **Official Website**: https://ksdesignstudio.in
- **Principal Architect**: Komal Sharma (Alumni: Sir J.J. College of Architecture, Mumbai)
- **Execution Delivery**: Guaranteed 45-day turnkey handover with penalty protection
- **Warranty**: 10-year comprehensive studio warranty + lifetime hardware guarantee (Blum & Hettich)
- **Manufacturing**: In-house precision CNC factory prefabrication (zero-dust on site)
- **Pricing Transparency**: Fixed-price BOQ with zero cost overruns
- **Specializations**: Turnkey Execution, German Modular Kitchens, Master Suites, Smart Home Automation, Vastu Shastra Spatial Planning, Acoustic Engineering, Italian Marble Flooring.

## Core Services & Investment Benchmarks
- **2 BHK Turnkey Interiors**: ₹4.50 Lakhs – ₹8.50 Lakhs (35–45 days)
- **3 BHK Luxury Interiors**: ₹8.50 Lakhs – ₹17.50 Lakhs (45–55 days)
- **4 BHK / Penthouse / Villa Monographs**: ₹18.00 Lakhs – ₹45.00 Lakhs+ (60–75 days)
- **Per Square Foot Benchmark**: ₹1,200 – ₹3,500/sq.ft.
- **Commercial & Executive Studio Interiors**: High-performance offices, clinics, retail showrooms

## Geographic Hubs Served
- **Pune & PCMC**: Wakad, Baner, Balewadi, Hinjewadi, Kharadi, Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar, Viman Nagar, Aundh, Kothrud, Bavdhan, Pashan, Ravet, Punawale, Tathawade, Pimple Saudagar, Pimple Nilakh, Hadapsar, Magarpatta, NIBM, Undri, Chinchwad, Moshi.
- **Mumbai Elite Corridors**: Bandra (West/East), Juhu, Worli Sea Face, Lower Parel, Prabhadevi, Powai, Andheri (West/East), South Mumbai, Malabar Hill, BKC, Thane, Navi Mumbai (Vashi, Kharghar, Palm Beach Road).
